subject: How to 'extend' existing MCMC calculation in nimble?

messages.author: 39971e2c19b8ec70
messages.subject: How to 'extend' existing MCMC calculation in nimble?
parts:
Hello,

say that I do MCMC calculation and figure out I need more iterations, is there a way to extend existing MCMC calculation, as it was possible in JAGS? Thanks. I tried to look into ?runMCMC, but I only found this note:

The MCMC option mcmc$run(..., reset = FALSE), used to continue execution of an MCMC chain, is not available through runMCMC().

But there isn't a reference to how it is possible now. Or does it mean it was possible before and isn't any more?

Thanks,

Tomas

messages.author: c9e9cbbfb3b043f0
messages.subject: Re: How to 'extend' existing MCMC calculation in nimble?
parts:
Tomas, if you've already used runMCMC(Cmcmc, ...), then yes, you can still extend the current MCMC chain, using:

Cmcmc$run(niter, reset = FALSE)

where niter is the number of additional MCMC iterations you wish to run.  After that, you can extract the full maxtrix of MCMC samples (which will include the ones you previously executed in the first call of runMCMC), using:

full_matrix_of_samples <- as.matrix(Cmcmc$mvSamples)

I hope this answers your question.

Daniel
